from __future__ import annotations

import json
import os
import sys

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd

from common import (
    AOV_FALLBACK, BASE_FEATURES, CAMPAIGN_TYPES, CATEGORIES, CHANNELS, CUTOFF,
    CUSTOMER_FEATURES, DATA_DIR, DELIVERY_STATUS, DEVICE, MARGIN_FALLBACK,
    MODEL_FEATURES, MODELING_DIR, OUT_DATA, PAYMENTS, SHIP_SPEEDS,
    SUPPORT_CHANNELS, TICKET_CATS, TIERS, TRAFFIC, counts, ensure_dirs,
    offer_catalogue, offer_cost_series, read_budget, read_csv, sample_ref,
    shares, to01,
)

sys.path.insert(0, MODELING_DIR)
from scoring import Scorer  # noqa: E402


def days_between(as_of: pd.Series, dates: pd.Series) -> pd.Series:
    return (as_of - pd.to_datetime(dates)).dt.days


def base_contact_frame(contacts: pd.DataFrame) -> pd.DataFrame:
    c = read_csv("customers.csv")
    c["signup_date"] = pd.to_datetime(c["signup_date"])
    c["email_open_rate_missing"] = c["email_open_rate"].isna().astype(int)
    c["has_referral"] = c["referral_code"].notna().astype(int)
    c["tier_ord"] = c["customer_tier"].map({"Bronze": 0, "Silver": 1, "Gold": 2, "Platinum": 3})
    c = c.rename(columns={
        "age": "cust_age", "country_code_clean": "cust_country", "region": "cust_region",
        "loyalty_score": "cust_loyalty", "email_open_rate": "cust_email_open",
        "discount_usage_rate": "cust_discount_rate", "avg_review_score": "cust_review",
        "customer_tier": "cust_tier", "credit_limit": "cust_credit_limit",
        "email_open_rate_missing": "cust_email_open_missing",
    })
    base = c[[
        "customer_id", "cust_age", "cust_country", "cust_region", "signup_date",
        "cust_loyalty", "cust_email_open", "cust_email_open_missing",
        "cust_discount_rate", "cust_review", "has_referral", "cust_tier", "tier_ord",
        "cust_credit_limit",
    ]].copy()

    geo = read_csv("geo_data.csv").rename(columns={
        "geo_ip_region": "cust_region", "average_income": "geo_income",
        "urban_ratio": "geo_urban", "internet_penetration": "geo_internet",
        "region_tier": "geo_tier",
    })
    base = base.merge(geo, on="cust_region", how="left")

    pref = read_csv("customer_preferences.csv")
    pref["last_updated"] = pd.to_datetime(pref["last_updated"])
    for col in ["email_opt_in_clean", "sms_opt_in_clean", "do_not_contact_clean"]:
        pref[col] = to01(pref[col])
    pref = pref.rename(columns={
        "email_opt_in_clean": "pref_email_opt", "sms_opt_in_clean": "pref_sms_opt",
        "preferred_channel": "pref_channel", "preferred_language": "pref_language",
        "do_not_contact_clean": "pref_dnc",
    })
    base = base.merge(
        pref[["customer_id", "pref_email_opt", "pref_sms_opt", "pref_channel",
              "pref_language", "pref_dnc", "last_updated"]],
        on="customer_id", how="left",
    )

    out = contacts.merge(base, on="customer_id", how="left")
    out["tenure_days"] = days_between(out["contact_date"], out["signup_date"])
    out["pref_days_since_update"] = days_between(out["contact_date"], out["last_updated"])
    out = out.drop(columns=["signup_date", "last_updated"])

    budget = read_budget().groupby("country")["retention_budget_usd"].mean()
    out["country_avg_weekly_budget"] = out["cust_country"].map(budget)

    offers = offer_catalogue()
    offers = offers.rename(columns={
        "value": "offer_value", "requires_promotable": "offer_requires_promotable",
        "counts_monthly": "offer_counts_monthly",
    })
    out = out.merge(
        offers[["offer_code", "offer_type", "offer_value", "offer_requires_promotable",
                "offer_counts_monthly", "eligible_tiers", "tier_list"]],
        on="offer_code", how="left",
    )

    def tier_match(tier, tier_list) -> int:
        if isinstance(tier_list, str):
            tier_list = [tier_list]
        if tier_list is None:
            return 0
        names = [str(t).strip() for t in tier_list]
        if any(t.lower() == "all" for t in names):
            return 1
        return int(str(tier) in names)

    out["tier_offer_match"] = [
        tier_match(t, v) for t, v in zip(out["cust_tier"], out["tier_list"])
    ]
    out["contact_channel_is_preferred"] = (
        out["channel"].astype(str) == out["pref_channel"].astype(str)
    ).astype(int)
    out = out.drop(columns=["eligible_tiers", "tier_list"])
    return out


def session_block(contacts: pd.DataFrame) -> pd.DataFrame:
    s = read_csv(
        "shopsphere_sessions_cleaned.csv",
        usecols=["customer_id", "session_timestamp", "session_duration", "pages_viewed",
                 "cart_additions", "campaign_id", "traffic_source_clean",
                 "device_type_clean", "bounce_clean", "campaign_status"],
    )
    s["event_date"] = pd.to_datetime(s["session_timestamp"]).dt.normalize()
    s["_bounce"] = to01(s["bounce_clean"])
    s["_camp"] = (s["campaign_status"] == "Has Campaign").astype(int)
    m = contacts[["contact_id", "customer_id", "contact_date"]].merge(s, on="customer_id", how="inner")
    m = m[m["event_date"] <= m["contact_date"]].copy()
    m["days_before"] = (m["contact_date"] - m["event_date"]).dt.days

    g = m.groupby("contact_id")
    f = pd.DataFrame(index=g.size().index)
    f["sess_n"] = g.size()
    f["sess_days_since_last"] = g["days_before"].min()
    f["sess_tenure_days"] = g["days_before"].max()
    for d in (30, 90, 180, 365):
        f[f"sess_n_{d}d"] = m.assign(_m=m["days_before"] <= d).groupby("contact_id")["_m"].sum()
    for col, out in [("session_duration", "dur"), ("pages_viewed", "pages"),
                     ("cart_additions", "cart")]:
        f[f"sess_{out}_mean"] = g[col].mean()
        f[f"sess_{out}_max"] = g[col].max()
        f[f"sess_{out}_sum"] = g[col].sum()
    f["sess_dur_std"] = g["session_duration"].std()
    f["sess_bounce_rate"] = g["_bounce"].mean()
    f["sess_campaign_rate"] = g["_camp"].mean()
    f["sess_campaign_n"] = g["_camp"].sum()
    f = f.join(shares(m, "contact_id", "traffic_source_clean", TRAFFIC, "sess_src_"))
    f = f.join(shares(m, "contact_id", "device_type_clean", DEVICE, "sess_dev_"))

    camp = read_csv("marketing_campaigns.csv", usecols=["campaign_id", "campaign_type"])
    sm = m[["contact_id", "campaign_id"]].dropna(subset=["campaign_id"]).copy()
    sm["campaign_id"] = sm["campaign_id"].astype("int64")
    sm = sm.merge(camp, on="campaign_id", how="left")
    f = f.join(shares(sm, "contact_id", "campaign_type", CAMPAIGN_TYPES, "sess_camptype_"))
    return f


def transaction_block(contacts: pd.DataFrame) -> tuple[pd.DataFrame, pd.DataFrame]:
    t = read_csv(
        "transactions.csv",
        usecols=["transaction_id", "customer_id", "transaction_timestamp", "order_value",
                 "items_count", "payment_method", "discount_applied_clean",
                 "shipping_speed", "high_value_flag_clean"],
    )
    t["event_date"] = pd.to_datetime(t["transaction_timestamp"]).dt.normalize()
    t["_disc"] = to01(t["discount_applied_clean"])
    t["_high"] = to01(t["high_value_flag_clean"])
    m = contacts[["contact_id", "customer_id", "contact_date"]].merge(t, on="customer_id", how="inner")
    m = m[m["event_date"] <= m["contact_date"]].copy()
    m["days_before"] = (m["contact_date"] - m["event_date"]).dt.days

    g = m.groupby("contact_id")
    f = pd.DataFrame(index=g.size().index)
    f["txn_n"] = g.size()
    f["txn_days_since_last"] = g["days_before"].min()
    f["txn_tenure_days"] = g["days_before"].max()
    for d in (30, 90, 180, 365):
        f[f"txn_n_{d}d"] = m.assign(_m=m["days_before"] <= d).groupby("contact_id")["_m"].sum()
        f[f"txn_spend_{d}d"] = m.assign(
            _v=np.where(m["days_before"] <= d, m["order_value"], 0.0)
        ).groupby("contact_id")["_v"].sum()
    for col, out in [("order_value", "value"), ("items_count", "items")]:
        f[f"txn_{out}_mean"] = g[col].mean()
        f[f"txn_{out}_max"] = g[col].max()
        f[f"txn_{out}_sum"] = g[col].sum()
    f["txn_value_std"] = g["order_value"].std()
    f["txn_value_median"] = g["order_value"].median()
    f["txn_discount_rate"] = g["_disc"].mean()
    f["txn_high_value_rate"] = g["_high"].mean()
    last = m.sort_values(["contact_id", "event_date"]).groupby("contact_id")
    f["txn_last_value"] = last["order_value"].last()
    f["txn_last_items"] = last["items_count"].last()
    f["txn_spend_per_day"] = f["txn_value_sum"] / f["txn_tenure_days"].replace(0, np.nan)
    f = f.join(shares(m, "contact_id", "payment_method", PAYMENTS, "txn_pay_"))
    f = f.join(shares(m, "contact_id", "shipping_speed", SHIP_SPEEDS, "txn_ship_"))
    return f, m


def item_block(txn_events: pd.DataFrame) -> pd.DataFrame:
    items = read_csv("transaction_items.csv")
    products = read_csv(
        "products.csv", usecols=["product_id", "category", "margin_pct", "is_promotable_clean"]
    )
    items = items.merge(products, on="product_id", how="left")
    items["line_value"] = items["quantity"] * items["unit_price"]
    items["_promo"] = to01(items["is_promotable_clean"]).fillna(0)
    m = txn_events[["contact_id", "transaction_id", "event_date", "days_before"]].merge(
        items, on="transaction_id", how="inner"
    )

    g = m.groupby("contact_id")
    f = pd.DataFrame(index=g.size().index)
    f["item_lines"] = g.size()
    f["item_qty"] = g["quantity"].sum()
    f["item_list_value"] = g["line_value"].sum()
    f["item_weighted_margin"] = (
        m.assign(_w=m["line_value"] * m["margin_pct"]).groupby("contact_id")["_w"].sum()
        / g["line_value"].sum().replace(0, np.nan)
    )
    low_margin = m.assign(
        _lm=np.where(m["margin_pct"] < 0.25, m["line_value"], 0.0)
    ).groupby("contact_id")["_lm"].sum()
    f["item_low_margin_share"] = low_margin / g["line_value"].sum().replace(0, np.nan)
    promo_value = m.assign(
        _pv=np.where(m["_promo"] == 1, m["line_value"], 0.0)
    ).groupby("contact_id")["_pv"].sum()
    f["item_promotable_share"] = promo_value / g["line_value"].sum().replace(0, np.nan)

    cat = m.groupby(["contact_id", "category"])["line_value"].sum().unstack(fill_value=0.0)
    cat = cat.reindex(columns=CATEGORIES, fill_value=0.0)
    cat = cat.div(cat.sum(axis=1).replace(0, np.nan), axis=0)
    cat.columns = [f"item_cat_{c}" for c in cat.columns]
    return f.join(cat)


def delivery_block(txn_events: pd.DataFrame) -> pd.DataFrame:
    d = read_csv(
        "deliveries.csv",
        usecols=["transaction_id", "carrier", "ship_date", "delivered_date", "delay_days",
                 "delivery_status"],
    )
    d["ship_date"] = pd.to_datetime(d["ship_date"])
    m = txn_events[["contact_id", "transaction_id", "contact_date", "event_date"]].merge(
        d, on="transaction_id", how="inner"
    )
    m = m[m["ship_date"] <= m["contact_date"]].copy()
    m["_late"] = (m["delivery_status"] == "Delivered Late").astype(int)
    m["_lost"] = (m["delivery_status"] == "Lost").astype(int)
    m["_returned"] = (m["delivery_status"] == "Returned").astype(int)
    m["_transit"] = (m["delivery_status"] == "In Transit").astype(int)

    g = m.groupby("contact_id")
    f = pd.DataFrame(index=g.size().index)
    f["del_n"] = g.size()
    f["del_carriers"] = g["carrier"].nunique()
    f["del_late_rate"] = g["_late"].mean()
    f["del_lost_rate"] = g["_lost"].mean()
    f["del_returned_rate"] = g["_returned"].mean()
    f["del_transit_rate"] = g["_transit"].mean()
    f["del_delay_mean"] = g["delay_days"].mean()
    f["del_delay_max"] = g["delay_days"].max()
    f["del_delay_sum"] = g["delay_days"].sum()
    f["del_last_status_late"] = (
        m.sort_values(["contact_id", "ship_date"]).groupby("contact_id")["_late"].last()
    )
    return f


def support_block(contacts: pd.DataFrame) -> pd.DataFrame:
    s = read_csv(
        "support_tickets.csv",
        usecols=["ticket_id", "customer_id", "created_date", "channel_clean", "category",
                 "priority", "status", "first_response_hours", "resolution_hours", "csat_score"],
    )
    s["event_date"] = pd.to_datetime(s["created_date"]).dt.normalize()
    s["_open"] = (s["status"] == "Open").astype(int)
    s["_high"] = (s["priority"] == "High").astype(int)
    s["_low_csat"] = (s["csat_score"] <= 2).astype(int)
    m = contacts[["contact_id", "customer_id", "contact_date"]].merge(s, on="customer_id", how="inner")
    m = m[m["event_date"] <= m["contact_date"]].copy()
    m["days_before"] = (m["contact_date"] - m["event_date"]).dt.days

    g = m.groupby("contact_id")
    f = pd.DataFrame(index=g.size().index)
    f["sup_n"] = g.size()
    f["sup_open_n"] = g["_open"].sum()
    f["sup_high_n"] = g["_high"].sum()
    f["sup_low_csat_n"] = g["_low_csat"].sum()
    f["sup_days_since_last"] = g["days_before"].min()
    f["sup_csat_mean"] = g["csat_score"].mean()
    f["sup_fr_mean"] = g["first_response_hours"].mean()
    f["sup_fr_max"] = g["first_response_hours"].max()
    f["sup_res_mean"] = g["resolution_hours"].mean()
    f["sup_res_max"] = g["resolution_hours"].max()
    f["sup_n_90d"] = m.assign(_m=m["days_before"] <= 90).groupby("contact_id")["_m"].sum()

    complaint_cats = ["Late delivery", "Damaged or wrong item", "Lost parcel", "Refund status"]
    recent = m[(m["days_before"] <= 90) & (m["category"].isin(complaint_cats))]
    f["sup_recent_complaint"] = f.index.isin(recent["contact_id"]).astype(int)
    f = f.join(counts(m, "contact_id", "category", TICKET_CATS, "sup_cat_"))
    f = f.join(shares(m, "contact_id", "channel_clean", SUPPORT_CHANNELS, "sup_ch_"))
    return f


def historical_features() -> pd.DataFrame:
    contacts = read_csv("retention_contact_history.csv")
    contacts["contact_date"] = pd.to_datetime(contacts["contact_date"])
    contacts["purchased_within_14d"] = to01(contacts["purchased_within_14d_clean"]).fillna(0).astype(int)
    contacts["redeemed"] = to01(contacts["redeemed_clean"])

    feats = base_contact_frame(contacts)
    print("  sessions")
    sess = session_block(contacts)
    print("  transactions")
    txn, txn_events = transaction_block(contacts)
    print("  items")
    items = item_block(txn_events)
    print("  deliveries")
    deliv = delivery_block(txn_events)
    print("  support")
    sup = support_block(contacts)

    feats = feats.merge(txn, left_on="contact_id", right_index=True, how="left")
    feats["expected_order_value"] = np.where(
        feats["txn_n_90d"].fillna(0) > 0,
        feats["txn_spend_90d"] / feats["txn_n_90d"].replace(0, np.nan),
        feats["txn_value_mean"],
    )
    feats["expected_order_value"] = feats["expected_order_value"].fillna(AOV_FALLBACK)
    feats["offer_cost"] = offer_cost_series(feats)

    for block in (sess, items, deliv, sup):
        feats = feats.merge(block, left_on="contact_id", right_index=True, how="left")

    feats["margin"] = feats["item_weighted_margin"].fillna(MARGIN_FALLBACK)
    feats["item_promotable_share"] = feats["item_promotable_share"].fillna(0.0)

    count_cols = [
        "sess_n", "sess_n_30d", "sess_n_90d", "sess_n_180d", "sess_n_365d",
        "sess_campaign_n", "txn_n", "txn_n_30d", "txn_n_90d", "txn_n_180d",
        "txn_n_365d", "item_lines", "item_qty", "del_n", "sup_n", "sup_open_n",
        "sup_high_n", "sup_low_csat_n", "sup_n_90d",
    ] + [f"sup_cat_{c}" for c in TICKET_CATS]
    for col in count_cols:
        if col in feats.columns:
            feats[col] = feats[col].fillna(0)
    for col in ["sup_recent_complaint"]:
        if col in feats.columns:
            feats[col] = feats[col].fillna(0).astype(int)

    for col in MODEL_FEATURES:
        if col not in feats.columns:
            feats[col] = np.nan
    feats["offer_requires_promotable"] = feats["offer_requires_promotable"].fillna(0).astype(int)
    feats["offer_counts_monthly"] = feats["offer_counts_monthly"].fillna(0).astype(int)
    feats["tier_offer_match"] = feats["tier_offer_match"].fillna(0).astype(int)
    feats["contact_channel_is_preferred"] = feats["contact_channel_is_preferred"].fillna(0).astype(int)
    return feats


def current_snapshot() -> pd.DataFrame:
    train = pd.read_pickle(os.path.join(MODELING_DIR, "features", "train_features.pkl"))
    test = pd.read_pickle(os.path.join(MODELING_DIR, "features", "test_features.pkl"))
    cur = pd.concat([train.drop(columns=["target"], errors="ignore"), test], ignore_index=True)
    cur["sample_ref"] = sample_ref(cur["customer_id"])

    txn = read_csv(
        "transactions.csv", usecols=["transaction_id", "customer_id", "transaction_timestamp"]
    )
    txn["event_date"] = pd.to_datetime(txn["transaction_timestamp"]).dt.normalize()
    txn = txn[txn["event_date"] <= CUTOFF]
    items = read_csv("transaction_items.csv", usecols=["transaction_id", "quantity", "unit_price", "product_id"])
    products = read_csv("products.csv", usecols=["product_id", "is_promotable_clean"])
    items = items.merge(products, on="product_id", how="left")
    items["line_value"] = items["quantity"] * items["unit_price"]
    items["_promo"] = to01(items["is_promotable_clean"]).fillna(0)
    items = items.merge(txn[["transaction_id", "customer_id"]], on="transaction_id", how="inner")
    promo = items.assign(
        _pv=np.where(items["_promo"] == 1, items["line_value"], 0.0)
    ).groupby("customer_id").agg(
        _promo_value=("_pv", "sum"), _value=("line_value", "sum")
    )
    promo["item_promotable_share"] = (
        promo["_promo_value"] / promo["_value"].replace(0, np.nan)
    )
    cur = cur.merge(promo[["item_promotable_share"]], left_on="customer_id",
                    right_index=True, how="left")
    cur["item_promotable_share"] = cur["item_promotable_share"].fillna(0.0)
    cur["expected_order_value"] = np.where(
        cur["txn_n_90d"].fillna(0) > 0,
        cur["txn_spend_90d"] / cur["txn_n_90d"].replace(0, np.nan),
        cur["txn_value_mean"],
    )
    cur["expected_order_value"] = cur["expected_order_value"].fillna(AOV_FALLBACK)
    cur["margin"] = cur["item_weighted_margin"].fillna(MARGIN_FALLBACK)

    r = read_csv("retention_contact_history.csv", usecols=["customer_id", "contact_date"])
    r["contact_date"] = pd.to_datetime(r["contact_date"])
    last = r.groupby("customer_id")["contact_date"].max().rename("last_contact_date")
    cur = cur.merge(last, left_on="customer_id", right_index=True, how="left")

    print("  scoring current customers with W1 ensemble")
    scorer = Scorer()
    cur["w1_probability"] = scorer.predict_proba(cur)
    cur["w1_target"] = (cur["w1_probability"] >= scorer.threshold).astype(int)
    return cur


def main() -> None:
    ensure_dirs()
    print("Building historical contact features ...")
    hist = historical_features()
    hist.to_pickle(os.path.join(OUT_DATA, "historical_contacts.pkl"))

    print("Building current customer snapshot ...")
    cur = current_snapshot()
    cur.to_pickle(os.path.join(OUT_DATA, "current_customers.pkl"))

    offers = offer_catalogue().drop(columns=["tier_list"])
    offers.to_csv(os.path.join(OUT_DATA, "offer_catalogue_clean.csv"), index=False)

    summary = {
        "historical_contacts": int(len(hist)),
        "historical_customers": int(hist["customer_id"].nunique()),
        "historical_purchase_rate": round(float(hist["purchased_within_14d"].mean()), 5),
        "current_customers": int(len(cur)),
        "current_w1_mean": round(float(cur["w1_probability"].mean()), 5),
        "current_w1_high_share": round(float(cur["w1_target"].mean()), 5),
        "model_features": len(MODEL_FEATURES),
        "categorical_features": [c for c in MODEL_FEATURES if c in
                                  ["cust_country", "cust_region", "cust_tier", "geo_tier",
                                   "pref_channel", "pref_language", "offer_code", "channel",
                                   "offer_type"]],
    }
    with open(os.path.join(OUT_DATA, "prep_summary.json"), "w", encoding="utf-8") as fh:
        json.dump(summary, fh, indent=2)
    print(json.dumps(summary, indent=2))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

from __future__ import annotations

import json
import os

import joblib
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd

from common import (
    CHANNELS, MODEL_FEATURES, OUT_DATA, OUT_MODELS, OUT_REPORTS,
    ensure_dirs, offer_catalogue, offer_cost_series, tiers_for_offer,
)

CHUNK = 10000


def channel_ok(df: pd.DataFrame) -> pd.Series:
    ok = pd.Series(True, index=df.index)
    ok &= df["channel"].eq("email") & df["pref_email_opt"].fillna(0).astype(int).eq(1) | \
        df["channel"].ne("email")
    ok &= df["channel"].eq("sms") & df["pref_sms_opt"].fillna(0).astype(int).eq(1) | \
        df["channel"].ne("sms")
    ok &= df["pref_dnc"].fillna(0).astype(int).eq(0)
    return ok


def service_ok(df: pd.DataFrame) -> pd.Series:
    recovery = df["sup_recent_complaint"].fillna(0).astype(int).eq(1) & \
        df["sup_open_n"].fillna(0).gt(0)
    return ~recovery | df["offer_code"].eq("OFF-SRC")


def tier_offer_lookup(offers: pd.DataFrame) -> pd.DataFrame:
    rows = []
    for _, offer in offers.iterrows():
        for tier in tiers_for_offer(offer):
            rows.append((offer["offer_code"], tier))
    return pd.DataFrame(rows, columns=["offer_code", "cust_tier"])


def candidate_frame(cur: pd.DataFrame, offers: pd.DataFrame) -> pd.DataFrame:
    cand = cur.merge(offers, how="cross")
    cand = cand[cand["offer_code"] != "OFF-NONE"].copy()
    lookup = tier_offer_lookup(offers)
    cand = cand.merge(lookup, on=["offer_code", "cust_tier"], how="inner")
    cand = cand[(cand["offer_requires_promotable"] == 0) |
                (cand["item_promotable_share"].fillna(0) > 0)].copy()
    cand = cand.merge(pd.DataFrame({"channel": CHANNELS}), how="cross")
    cand = cand[channel_ok(cand) & service_ok(cand)].copy()
    cand["tier_offer_match"] = 1
    cand["contact_channel_is_preferred"] = (
        cand["channel"].astype(str) == cand["pref_channel"].astype(str)
    ).astype(int)
    cand["offer_face_value"] = offer_cost_series(cand)
    cand["offer_cost"] = cand["offer_face_value"]
    return cand


def baseline_frame(cur: pd.DataFrame, offers: pd.DataFrame) -> pd.DataFrame:
    none_offer = offers[offers["offer_code"] == "OFF-NONE"].iloc[0]
    base = cur.copy()
    for col in ["offer_code", "offer_type", "offer_value", "eligible_tiers"]:
        base[col] = none_offer[col]
    base["offer_requires_promotable"] = int(none_offer["offer_requires_promotable"])
    base["offer_counts_monthly"] = int(none_offer["offer_counts_monthly"])
    base = base.merge(pd.DataFrame({"channel": CHANNELS}), how="cross")
    base = base[channel_ok(base)].copy()
    base["tier_offer_match"] = 1
    base["contact_channel_is_preferred"] = (
        base["channel"].astype(str) == base["pref_channel"].astype(str)
    ).astype(int)
    base["offer_face_value"] = 0.0
    base["offer_cost"] = 0.0
    return base


def main() -> None:
    ensure_dirs()
    cur = pd.read_pickle(os.path.join(OUT_DATA, "current_customers.pkl"))
    offers = offer_catalogue().rename(columns={
        "value": "offer_value", "requires_promotable": "offer_requires_promotable",
        "counts_monthly": "offer_counts_monthly",
    })
    pre = joblib.load(os.path.join(OUT_MODELS, "offer_preprocessor.joblib"))
    purchase = joblib.load(os.path.join(OUT_MODELS, "purchase_model.joblib"))
    redemption = joblib.load(os.path.join(OUT_MODELS, "redemption_model.joblib"))
    with open(os.path.join(OUT_MODELS, "offer_meta.json"), encoding="utf-8") as fh:
        meta = json.load(fh)

    keep = [
        "customer_id", "sample_ref", "cust_country", "cust_region", "cust_tier",
        "pref_channel", "last_contact_date", "expected_order_value", "margin",
        "w1_probability", "w1_target",
    ]
    base_cols = list(dict.fromkeys(keep + MODEL_FEATURES + [
        "pref_email_opt", "pref_sms_opt", "pref_dnc", "sup_open_n",
        "sup_recent_complaint", "item_promotable_share",
    ]))
    cur = cur[[c for c in base_cols if c in cur.columns]].copy()

    rows = []
    for start in range(0, len(cur), CHUNK):
        chunk = cur.iloc[start:start + CHUNK].copy()
        cand = candidate_frame(chunk, offers)
        base = baseline_frame(chunk, offers)

        Xc = pre.transform(cand[MODEL_FEATURES]).astype(np.float32)
        cand["purchase_probability"] = purchase.predict_proba(Xc)[:, 1]
        cand["redemption_probability"] = redemption.predict_proba(Xc)[:, 1]
        cand["offer_cost"] = cand["offer_face_value"] * cand["redemption_probability"]

        Xb = pre.transform(base[MODEL_FEATURES]).astype(np.float32)
        base["baseline_probability"] = purchase.predict_proba(Xb)[:, 1]
        cand = cand.merge(
            base[["customer_id", "channel", "baseline_probability"]],
            on=["customer_id", "channel"], how="left",
        )
        cand["uplift"] = cand["purchase_probability"] - cand["baseline_probability"]
        cand["expected_incremental_revenue"] = cand["uplift"] * cand["expected_order_value"]
        cand["expected_incremental_margin"] = (
            cand["expected_incremental_revenue"] * cand["margin"]
        )
        cand["expected_net_value"] = cand["expected_incremental_margin"] - cand["offer_cost"]
        cand["roi"] = np.where(
            cand["offer_cost"] > 0,
            cand["expected_net_value"] / cand["offer_cost"].replace(0, np.nan),
            np.nan,
        )

        out_cols = [
            "sample_ref", "cust_country", "cust_region", "cust_tier", "channel",
            "offer_code", "offer_type", "offer_value", "purchase_probability",
            "baseline_probability", "uplift", "redemption_probability",
            "expected_order_value", "margin", "offer_face_value", "offer_cost",
            "expected_incremental_revenue", "expected_incremental_margin",
            "expected_net_value", "roi", "pref_channel", "w1_probability",
            "w1_target", "last_contact_date",
        ]
        rows.append(cand[out_cols].copy())
        print(f"scored {min(start + CHUNK, len(cur)):,}/{len(cur):,} customers")

    scores = pd.concat(rows, ignore_index=True)
    for col in ["purchase_probability", "baseline_probability", "uplift",
                "redemption_probability", "expected_order_value", "margin", "offer_cost",
                "offer_face_value", "expected_incremental_revenue", "expected_incremental_margin",
                "expected_net_value", "roi", "w1_probability"]:
        scores[col] = pd.to_numeric(scores[col], errors="coerce").astype("float32")
    scores["w1_target"] = scores["w1_target"].fillna(0).astype("int8")
    scores["last_contact_date"] = pd.to_datetime(scores["last_contact_date"], errors="coerce")

    path = os.path.join(OUT_DATA, "offer_candidate_scores.parquet")
    scores.to_parquet(path, index=False)
    summary = {
        "rows": int(len(scores)),
        "customers": int(scores["sample_ref"].nunique()),
        "offers": sorted(scores["offer_code"].unique().tolist()),
        "channels": sorted(scores["channel"].unique().tolist()),
        "countries": sorted(scores["cust_country"].unique().tolist()),
        "positive_uplift_share": round(float((scores["uplift"] > 0).mean()), 5),
        "positive_net_share": round(float((scores["expected_net_value"] > 0).mean()), 5),
        "selected_purchase_model": meta["selected_purchase_model"],
    }
    with open(os.path.join(OUT_REPORTS, "offer_candidate_summary.json"), "w", encoding="utf-8") as fh:
        json.dump(summary, fh, indent=2)
    print(json.dumps(summary, indent=2))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

"""Shared PyTorch MLP definition for the ShopSphere propensity model."""

from __future__ import annotations

import torch
import torch.nn as nn


class MLP(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, n_in: int, hidden: tuple[int, int, int] = (256, 128, 64),
                 dropout: tuple[float, float, float] = (0.35, 0.30, 0.20)):
        super().__init__()
        h1, h2, h3 = hidden
        d1, d2, d3 = dropout
        self.net = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(n_in, h1), nn.BatchNorm1d(h1), nn.ReLU(), nn.Dropout(d1),
            nn.Linear(h1, h2), nn.BatchNorm1d(h2), nn.ReLU(), nn.Dropout(d2),
            nn.Linear(h2, h3), nn.BatchNorm1d(h3), nn.ReLU(), nn.Dropout(d3),
            nn.Linear(h3, 1),
        )

    def forward(self, x: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
        return self.net(x).squeeze(1)

"""As-of customer feature engineering for rolling ShopSphere predictions.

The original ``build_features.py`` is tied to the October 2024 checkpoint.
This module generalises the same feature blocks so a snapshot can be built for
any as-of date.  It deliberately keeps the original feature names and adds a
target-window seasonality block, so the existing offer model can continue to
use the customer features it was trained on.

Typical use::

    raw = load_raw()
    feats = build_feature_frame(raw, as_of="2024-06-30")
    labelled = build_snapshot(raw, "2024-06-30")   # features + target
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import os

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd

from asof_time import (
    month_end_dates,
    next_black_friday,
    next_christmas,
    resolve_as_of,
    target_months,
    weekly_dates,
    window_bounds,
)

BASE = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))
DATA = os.path.join(BASE, "..", "shopsphere_data")
WINDOW_DAYS = 30

TRAFFIC = ["organic", "direct", "ads", "email", "social"]
DEVICE = ["mobile", "desktop", "tablet"]
CAMPAIGN_TYPES = ["Email", "Search", "Display", "Social", "Affiliate"]
PAYMENTS = ["credit_card", "debit_card", "paypal", "crypto"]
SHIP_SPEEDS = ["standard", "express", "overnight"]
DELIVERY_STATUS = ["Delivered", "Delivered Late", "Lost", "Returned", "In Transit"]
TICKET_CATS = [
    "Late delivery", "Damaged or wrong item", "Product question", "Refund status",
    "Lost parcel", "Payment issue", "Account access", "Promo code not working", "Cancel order",
]
RET_CHANNELS = ["email", "app_push", "sms"]


# --------------------------------------------------------------------------- #
# I/O
# --------------------------------------------------------------------------- #
def read(name: str, data_dir: str = DATA, **kwargs) -> pd.DataFrame:
    return pd.read_csv(os.path.join(data_dir, name), low_memory=False, **kwargs)


def load_raw(data_dir: str = DATA) -> dict[str, pd.DataFrame]:
    """Load the source tables once; every snapshot reuses the same frames."""
    return {
        "customers": read("customers.csv", data_dir),
        "geo": read("geo_data.csv", data_dir),
        "preferences": read("customer_preferences.csv", data_dir),
        "sessions": read("shopsphere_sessions_cleaned.csv", data_dir),
        "transactions": read("transactions.csv", data_dir),
        "transaction_items": read("transaction_items.csv", data_dir),
        "products": read("products.csv", data_dir),
        "deliveries": read("deliveries.csv", data_dir),
        "support_tickets": read("support_tickets.csv", data_dir),
        "retention_contacts": read("retention_contact_history.csv", data_dir),
        "campaigns": read("marketing_campaigns.csv", data_dir),
        "campaign_performance": read("campaign_daily_performance.csv", data_dir),
        "budget": read("retention_budget_2024Q4.csv", data_dir),
    }


def to01(series: pd.Series) -> pd.Series:
    if pd.api.types.is_bool_dtype(series):
        return series.astype("int64")
    low = series.astype("string").str.strip().str.lower()
    return low.map({
        "true": 1, "false": 0, "y": 1, "n": 0, "yes": 1, "no": 0,
        "1": 1, "0": 0, "t": 1, "f": 0,
    })


def days_since(dates: pd.Series, as_of) -> pd.Series:
    return (pd.Timestamp(as_of) - pd.to_datetime(dates)).dt.days


def shares(df: pd.DataFrame, id_col: str, cat_col: str, categories: list[str], prefix: str) -> pd.DataFrame:
    tmp = df[[id_col, cat_col]].dropna()
    tab = tmp.groupby([id_col, cat_col]).size().unstack(fill_value=0)
    tab = tab.reindex(columns=categories, fill_value=0)
    out = tab.div(tab.sum(axis=1).replace(0, np.nan), axis=0)
    out.columns = [f"{prefix}{c}" for c in out.columns]
    return out


def counts(df: pd.DataFrame, id_col: str, cat_col: str, categories: list[str], prefix: str) -> pd.DataFrame:
    tmp = df[[id_col, cat_col]].dropna()
    tab = tmp.groupby([id_col, cat_col]).size().unstack(fill_value=0)
    tab = tab.reindex(columns=categories, fill_value=0)
    tab.columns = [f"{prefix}{c}" for c in tab.columns]
    return tab


# --------------------------------------------------------------------------- #
# Feature blocks
# --------------------------------------------------------------------------- #
def customer_base(raw: dict[str, pd.DataFrame], as_of) -> pd.DataFrame:
    c = raw["customers"].copy()
    c["tenure_days"] = days_since(c["signup_date"], as_of)
    c["email_open_rate_missing"] = c["email_open_rate"].isna().astype(int)
    c["has_referral"] = c["referral_code"].notna().astype(int)
    c["tier_ord"] = c["customer_tier"].map({"Bronze": 0, "Silver": 1, "Gold": 2, "Platinum": 3})
    c = c.rename(columns={
        "age": "cust_age", "country_code_clean": "cust_country", "region": "cust_region",
        "loyalty_score": "cust_loyalty", "email_open_rate": "cust_email_open",
        "discount_usage_rate": "cust_discount_rate", "avg_review_score": "cust_review",
        "customer_tier": "cust_tier", "credit_limit": "cust_credit_limit",
        "email_open_rate_missing": "cust_email_open_missing",
    })
    keep = ["customer_id", "cust_age", "cust_country", "cust_region", "tenure_days",
            "cust_loyalty", "cust_email_open", "cust_email_open_missing",
            "cust_discount_rate", "cust_review", "has_referral", "cust_tier", "tier_ord",
            "cust_credit_limit"]
    base = c[keep].copy()

    geo = raw["geo"].rename(columns={
        "geo_ip_region": "cust_region", "average_income": "geo_income",
        "urban_ratio": "geo_urban", "internet_penetration": "geo_internet",
        "region_tier": "geo_tier",
    })
    base = base.merge(geo, on="cust_region", how="left")

    pref = raw["preferences"].copy()
    pref["pref_days_since_update"] = days_since(pref["last_updated"], as_of)
    for col in ["email_opt_in_clean", "sms_opt_in_clean", "do_not_contact_clean"]:
        pref[col] = to01(pref[col])
    pref = pref.rename(columns={
        "email_opt_in_clean": "pref_email_opt", "sms_opt_in_clean": "pref_sms_opt",
        "preferred_channel": "pref_channel", "preferred_language": "pref_language",
        "do_not_contact_clean": "pref_dnc",
    })
    base = base.merge(
        pref[["customer_id", "pref_email_opt", "pref_sms_opt", "pref_channel",
              "pref_language", "pref_dnc", "pref_days_since_update"]],
        on="customer_id", how="left",
    )
    return base


def _window_month_flags(events: pd.DataFrame, as_of, date_col: str) -> pd.DataFrame:
    start, end = window_bounds(as_of, WINDOW_DAYS)
    months = target_months(as_of, WINDOW_DAYS)
    target_holiday = bool(months & {11, 12})
    events = events.copy()
    events["_month"] = events[date_col].dt.month
    events["_is_target_month"] = events["_month"].isin(months).astype(int)
    events["_is_target_holiday"] = (
        events["_month"].isin([11, 12]) if target_holiday else pd.Series(False, index=events.index)
    ).astype(int)
    return events, start, end, months, target_holiday


def session_features(raw: dict[str, pd.DataFrame], as_of) -> pd.DataFrame:
    s = raw["sessions"].copy()
    s["ts"] = pd.to_datetime(s["session_timestamp"])
    s = s[s["ts"] <= pd.Timestamp(as_of)].copy()
    s["_bounce"] = to01(s["bounce_clean"])
    s["_camp"] = (s["campaign_status"] == "Has Campaign").astype(int)

    g = s.groupby("customer_id")
    f = pd.DataFrame(index=g.size().index)
    f["sess_n"] = g.size()
    f["sess_days_since_last"] = days_since(g["ts"].max(), as_of)
    f["sess_tenure_days"] = days_since(g["ts"].min(), as_of)
    for d in (30, 90, 180, 365):
        f[f"sess_n_{d}d"] = s.assign(
            _m=s["ts"] >= pd.Timestamp(as_of) - pd.Timedelta(days=d)
        ).groupby("customer_id")["_m"].sum()
    for col, out in [("session_duration", "dur"), ("pages_viewed", "pages"),
                     ("cart_additions", "cart")]:
        f[f"sess_{out}_mean"] = g[col].mean()
        f[f"sess_{out}_max"] = g[col].max()
        f[f"sess_{out}_sum"] = g[col].sum()
    f["sess_dur_std"] = g["session_duration"].std()
    f["sess_bounce_rate"] = g["_bounce"].mean()
    f["sess_campaign_rate"] = g["_camp"].mean()
    f["sess_campaign_n"] = g["_camp"].sum()

    f = f.join(shares(s, "customer_id", "traffic_source_clean", TRAFFIC, "sess_src_"))
    f = f.join(shares(s, "customer_id", "device_type_clean", DEVICE, "sess_dev_"))

    # Legacy fixed-window features (kept so the original model keeps working).
    s["_year_month"] = s["ts"].dt.to_period("M")
    s["_is_oct"] = s["ts"].dt.month.eq(10).astype(int)
    s["_is_holiday"] = s["ts"].dt.month.isin([11, 12]).astype(int)
    s["_is_q4"] = s["ts"].dt.month.isin([10, 11, 12]).astype(int)
    seas = s.groupby("customer_id").agg(
        sess_oct_n=("_is_oct", "sum"),
        sess_holiday_n=("_is_holiday", "sum"),
        sess_q4_n=("_is_q4", "sum"),
    )
    seas["sess_oct_share"] = seas["sess_oct_n"] / f["sess_n"]
    seas["sess_holiday_share"] = seas["sess_holiday_n"] / f["sess_n"]
    seas["sess_q4_share"] = seas["sess_q4_n"] / f["sess_n"]
    monthly = s.groupby(["customer_id", "_year_month"]).size().rename("n").reset_index()
    mg = monthly.groupby("customer_id")["n"]
    seas["sess_monthly_mean"] = mg.mean()
    seas["sess_monthly_max"] = mg.max()
    seas["sess_seasonal_index"] = (
        seas["sess_monthly_max"] / seas["sess_monthly_mean"].replace(0, np.nan)
    )

    # Target-window seasonality block.
    s2, _, _, months, target_holiday = _window_month_flags(s, as_of, "ts")
    target = s2.groupby("customer_id").agg(
        sess_target_month_n=("_is_target_month", "sum"),
        sess_target_holiday_n=("_is_target_holiday", "sum"),
    )
    target["sess_target_month_share"] = target["sess_target_month_n"] / f["sess_n"]
    target["sess_target_month_active"] = (target["sess_target_month_n"] > 0).astype(int)
    target["sess_target_holiday_share"] = target["sess_target_holiday_n"] / f["sess_n"]
    target["sess_target_holiday_active"] = (target["sess_target_holiday_n"] > 0).astype(int)
    if not target_holiday:
        target["sess_target_holiday_share"] = 0.0
        target["sess_target_holiday_active"] = 0
    seas = seas.join(target)
    f = f.join(seas)

    camp = raw["campaigns"][["campaign_id", "campaign_type"]]
    sm = s[["customer_id", "campaign_id"]].dropna(subset=["campaign_id"]).copy()
    sm["campaign_id"] = sm["campaign_id"].astype("int64")
    sm = sm.merge(camp, on="campaign_id", how="left")
    f = f.join(shares(sm, "customer_id", "campaign_type", CAMPAIGN_TYPES, "sess_camptype_"))
    return f


def transaction_features(raw: dict[str, pd.DataFrame], as_of) -> tuple[pd.DataFrame, pd.DataFrame]:
    t = raw["transactions"].copy()
    t["d"] = pd.to_datetime(t["transaction_timestamp"])
    t = t[t["d"] <= pd.Timestamp(as_of)].sort_values(["customer_id", "d"]).copy()
    t["_disc"] = to01(t["discount_applied_clean"])
    t["_high"] = to01(t["high_value_flag_clean"])

    g = t.groupby("customer_id")
    f = pd.DataFrame(index=g.size().index)
    f["txn_n"] = g.size()
    f["txn_days_since_last"] = days_since(g["d"].max(), as_of)
    f["txn_tenure_days"] = days_since(g["d"].min(), as_of)
    for d in (30, 90, 180, 365):
        f[f"txn_n_{d}d"] = t.assign(
            _m=t["d"] >= pd.Timestamp(as_of) - pd.Timedelta(days=d)
        ).groupby("customer_id")["_m"].sum()
        f[f"txn_spend_{d}d"] = t.assign(
            _v=np.where(t["d"] >= pd.Timestamp(as_of) - pd.Timedelta(days=d),
                        t["order_value"], 0.0)
        ).groupby("customer_id")["_v"].sum()
    for col, out in [("order_value", "value"), ("items_count", "items")]:
        f[f"txn_{out}_mean"] = g[col].mean()
        f[f"txn_{out}_max"] = g[col].max()
        f[f"txn_{out}_sum"] = g[col].sum()
    f["txn_value_std"] = g["order_value"].std()
    f["txn_value_median"] = g["order_value"].median()
    f["txn_discount_rate"] = g["_disc"].mean()
    f["txn_high_value_rate"] = g["_high"].mean()
    f["txn_last_value"] = g["order_value"].last()
    f["txn_last_items"] = g["items_count"].last()
    f["txn_spend_per_day"] = f["txn_value_sum"] / f["txn_tenure_days"].replace(0, np.nan)

    f = f.join(shares(t, "customer_id", "payment_method", PAYMENTS, "txn_pay_"))
    f = f.join(shares(t, "customer_id", "shipping_speed", SHIP_SPEEDS, "txn_ship_"))

    # Legacy fixed-window features.
    t["_year_month"] = t["d"].dt.to_period("M")
    t["_is_oct"] = t["d"].dt.month.eq(10).astype(int)
    t["_is_holiday"] = t["d"].dt.month.isin([11, 12]).astype(int)
    t["_is_q4"] = t["d"].dt.month.isin([10, 11, 12]).astype(int)
    seas = t.groupby("customer_id").agg(
        txn_oct_n=("_is_oct", "sum"),
        txn_holiday_n=("_is_holiday", "sum"),
        txn_q4_n=("_is_q4", "sum"),
    )
    seas["txn_oct_share"] = seas["txn_oct_n"] / f["txn_n"]
    seas["txn_holiday_share"] = seas["txn_holiday_n"] / f["txn_n"]
    seas["txn_q4_share"] = seas["txn_q4_n"] / f["txn_n"]
    seas["txn_oct_active"] = (seas["txn_oct_n"] > 0).astype(int)
    seas["txn_holiday_active"] = (seas["txn_holiday_n"] > 0).astype(int)
    monthly = t.groupby(["customer_id", "_year_month"]).size().rename("n").reset_index()
    mg = monthly.groupby("customer_id")["n"]
    seas["txn_monthly_mean"] = mg.mean()
    seas["txn_monthly_max"] = mg.max()
    seas["txn_monthly_std"] = mg.std()
    seas["txn_seasonal_index"] = (
        seas["txn_monthly_max"] / seas["txn_monthly_mean"].replace(0, np.nan)
    )
    seas["txn_month_cv"] = (
        seas["txn_monthly_std"] / seas["txn_monthly_mean"].replace(0, np.nan)
    )
    last_oct = t[t["_is_oct"] == 1].groupby("customer_id")["d"].max()
    seas["txn_days_since_last_oct"] = days_since(last_oct, as_of)
    f = f.join(seas)
    f["txn_dormant_holiday_affinity"] = (
        (f["txn_days_since_last"] > 180).astype(int) * f["txn_holiday_share"]
    )

    # Target-window seasonality block.
    t2, _, _, _, target_holiday = _window_month_flags(t, as_of, "d")
    target = t2.groupby("customer_id").agg(
        txn_target_month_n=("_is_target_month", "sum"),
        txn_target_holiday_n=("_is_target_holiday", "sum"),
    )
    target["txn_target_month_share"] = target["txn_target_month_n"] / f["txn_n"]
    target["txn_target_month_active"] = (target["txn_target_month_n"] > 0).astype(int)
    target["txn_target_holiday_share"] = target["txn_target_holiday_n"] / f["txn_n"]
    target["txn_target_holiday_active"] = (target["txn_target_holiday_n"] > 0).astype(int)
    if not target_holiday:
        target["txn_target_holiday_share"] = 0.0
        target["txn_target_holiday_active"] = 0
    last_target = t2[t2["_is_target_month"] == 1].groupby("customer_id")["d"].max()
    target["txn_days_since_last_target_month"] = days_since(last_target, as_of)
    f = f.join(target)
    f["txn_dormant_target_affinity"] = (
        (f["txn_days_since_last"] > 180).astype(int) * f["txn_target_month_share"]
    )
    f["txn_target_holiday_affinity"] = (
        (f["txn_days_since_last"] > 180).astype(int) * f["txn_target_holiday_share"]
    )
    return f, t


def item_features(raw: dict[str, pd.DataFrame], txn: pd.DataFrame) -> pd.DataFrame:
    items = raw["transaction_items"].copy()
    products = raw["products"][["product_id", "category", "margin_pct", "is_promotable_clean"]].copy()
    items = items.merge(products, on="product_id", how="left")
    items["line_value"] = items["quantity"] * items["unit_price"]
    items["_promo"] = to01(items["is_promotable_clean"]).fillna(0)
    items = items.merge(txn[["transaction_id", "customer_id", "d"]], on="transaction_id", how="left")
    items = items.dropna(subset=["customer_id"])
    items["customer_id"] = items["customer_id"].astype("int64")

    g = items.groupby("customer_id")
    f = pd.DataFrame(index=g.size().index)
    f["item_lines"] = g.size()
    f["item_qty"] = g["quantity"].sum()
    f["item_list_value"] = g["line_value"].sum()
    f["item_weighted_margin"] = (
        items.assign(_w=items["line_value"] * items["margin_pct"]).groupby("customer_id")["_w"].sum()
        / g["line_value"].sum().replace(0, np.nan)
    )
    low_margin = items.assign(
        _lm=np.where(items["margin_pct"] < 0.25, items["line_value"], 0.0)
    ).groupby("customer_id")["_lm"].sum()
    f["item_low_margin_share"] = low_margin / g["line_value"].sum().replace(0, np.nan)
    promo_value = items.assign(
        _pv=np.where(items["_promo"] == 1, items["line_value"], 0.0)
    ).groupby("customer_id")["_pv"].sum()
    f["item_promotable_share"] = promo_value / g["line_value"].sum().replace(0, np.nan)

    cat = items.groupby(["customer_id", "category"])["line_value"].sum().unstack(fill_value=0.0)
    cat = cat.div(cat.sum(axis=1).replace(0, np.nan), axis=0)
    cat.columns = [f"item_cat_{c}" for c in cat.columns]
    return f.join(cat)


def delivery_features(raw: dict[str, pd.DataFrame], txn: pd.DataFrame) -> pd.DataFrame:
    d = raw["deliveries"].copy()
    d["ship_date"] = pd.to_datetime(d["ship_date"])
    d = d[d["ship_date"] <= pd.Timestamp(as_of)] if "as_of" in locals() else d
    d = d.merge(txn[["transaction_id", "customer_id", "d"]].rename(columns={"d": "txn_d"}),
                on="transaction_id", how="left")
    d = d.dropna(subset=["customer_id"])
    d["customer_id"] = d["customer_id"].astype("int64")
    d["_late"] = (d["delivery_status"] == "Delivered Late").astype(int)
    d["_lost"] = (d["delivery_status"] == "Lost").astype(int)
    d["_returned"] = (d["delivery_status"] == "Returned").astype(int)
    d["_transit"] = (d["delivery_status"] == "In Transit").astype(int)

    g = d.groupby("customer_id")
    f = pd.DataFrame(index=g.size().index)
    f["del_n"] = g.size()
    f["del_carriers"] = g["carrier"].nunique()
    f["del_late_rate"] = g["_late"].mean()
    f["del_lost_rate"] = g["_lost"].mean()
    f["del_returned_rate"] = g["_returned"].mean()
    f["del_transit_rate"] = g["_transit"].mean()
    f["del_delay_mean"] = g["delay_days"].mean()
    f["del_delay_max"] = g["delay_days"].max()
    f["del_delay_sum"] = g["delay_days"].sum()
    f["del_last_status_late"] = (
        d.sort_values(["customer_id", "txn_d"]).groupby("customer_id")["_late"].last()
    )
    return f


def support_features(raw: dict[str, pd.DataFrame], as_of) -> pd.DataFrame:
    s = raw["support_tickets"].copy()
    s["d"] = pd.to_datetime(s["created_date"])
    s = s[s["d"] <= pd.Timestamp(as_of)].copy()
    s["_open"] = (s["status"] == "Open").astype(int)
    s["_high"] = (s["priority"] == "High").astype(int)
    s["_low_csat"] = (s["csat_score"] <= 2).astype(int)

    g = s.groupby("customer_id")
    f = pd.DataFrame(index=g.size().index)
    f["sup_n"] = g.size()
    f["sup_open_n"] = g["_open"].sum()
    f["sup_high_n"] = g["_high"].sum()
    f["sup_low_csat_n"] = g["_low_csat"].sum()
    f["sup_days_since_last"] = days_since(g["d"].max(), as_of)
    f["sup_csat_mean"] = g["csat_score"].mean()
    f["sup_fr_mean"] = g["first_response_hours"].mean()
    f["sup_fr_max"] = g["first_response_hours"].max()
    f["sup_res_mean"] = g["resolution_hours"].mean()
    f["sup_res_max"] = g["resolution_hours"].max()
    f["sup_n_90d"] = s.assign(
        _m=s["d"] >= pd.Timestamp(as_of) - pd.Timedelta(days=90)
    ).groupby("customer_id")["_m"].sum()

    f = f.join(counts(s, "customer_id", "category", TICKET_CATS, "sup_cat_"))
    f = f.join(shares(s, "customer_id", "channel_clean", ["Live chat", "Email", "WhatsApp", "Phone"], "sup_ch_"))

    complaint_cats = ["Late delivery", "Damaged or wrong item", "Lost parcel", "Refund status"]
    recent = s[(s["d"] >= pd.Timestamp(as_of) - pd.Timedelta(days=90)) &
               (s["category"].isin(complaint_cats))]
    f["sup_recent_complaint"] = f.index.isin(recent["customer_id"]).astype(int)
    return f


def retention_features(raw: dict[str, pd.DataFrame], as_of) -> pd.DataFrame:
    r = raw["retention_contacts"].copy()
    r["d"] = pd.to_datetime(r["contact_date"])
    r = r[r["d"] <= pd.Timestamp(as_of)].copy()
    r["_redeemed"] = to01(r["redeemed_clean"])
    r["_p14"] = to01(r["purchased_within_14d_clean"])
    r["_no_offer"] = (r["offer_code"] == "OFF-NONE").astype(int)
    r["_v20"] = (r["offer_code"] == "OFF-V20").astype(int)

    g = r.groupby("customer_id")
    f = pd.DataFrame(index=g.size().index)
    f["ret_n"] = g.size()
    f["ret_redeemed_n"] = g["_redeemed"].sum()
    f["ret_redeem_rate"] = g["_redeemed"].mean()
    f["ret_purch14_rate"] = g["_p14"].mean()
    f["ret_no_offer_n"] = g["_no_offer"].sum()
    f["ret_v20_n"] = g["_v20"].sum()
    f["ret_days_since_last"] = days_since(g["d"].max(), as_of)
    f = f.join(shares(r, "customer_id", "channel", RET_CHANNELS, "ret_ch_"))
    return f


def region_marketing_features(raw: dict[str, pd.DataFrame], as_of) -> pd.DataFrame:
    camp = raw["campaigns"].copy()
    camp["start_date"] = pd.to_datetime(camp["start_date"])
    camp = camp[camp["start_date"] <= pd.Timestamp(as_of)]
    perf = raw["campaign_performance"].copy()
    perf["date"] = pd.to_datetime(perf["date"])
    perf = perf[perf["date"] <= pd.Timestamp(as_of)]
    agg = perf.groupby("campaign_id").agg(
        spend=("spend", "sum"), revenue=("attributed_revenue", "sum"),
        orders=("attributed_orders", "sum"), clicks=("clicks", "sum"),
        impressions=("impressions", "sum"),
    ).reset_index()
    camp = camp.merge(agg, on="campaign_id", how="left")
    reg = camp.groupby("region_target").agg(
        reg_spend=("spend", "sum"), reg_revenue=("revenue", "sum"),
        reg_orders=("orders", "sum"), reg_clicks=("clicks", "sum"),
        reg_impressions=("impressions", "sum"), reg_campaigns=("campaign_id", "count"),
        reg_budget_mean=("campaign_budget", "mean"),
    )
    reg["reg_roas"] = reg["reg_revenue"] / reg["reg_spend"].replace(0, np.nan)
    reg["reg_ctr"] = reg["reg_clicks"] / reg["reg_impressions"].replace(0, np.nan)

    recent = perf[perf["date"] >= pd.Timestamp(as_of) - pd.Timedelta(days=90)]
    recent = recent.merge(camp[["campaign_id", "region_target"]], on="campaign_id", how="left")
    reg_recent = recent.groupby("region_target")["spend"].sum().rename("reg_spend_90d")
    reg = reg.join(reg_recent)
    reg.index.name = "cust_region"
    return reg


def country_budget(raw: dict[str, pd.DataFrame]) -> pd.Series:
    rb = raw["budget"]
    return rb.groupby("country")["retention_budget_usd"].mean().rename("country_avg_weekly_budget")


# --------------------------------------------------------------------------- #
# Target-window seasonality context
# --------------------------------------------------------------------------- #
def seasonality_context(raw: dict[str, pd.DataFrame], as_of) -> dict:
    start, end = window_bounds(as_of, WINDOW_DAYS)
    months = target_months(as_of, WINDOW_DAYS)
    bf = next_black_friday(start)
    xmas = next_christmas(start)
    start_month = start.month

    tx = raw["transactions"][["transaction_id", "customer_id", "transaction_timestamp", "order_value"]].copy()
    tx["d"] = pd.to_datetime(tx["transaction_timestamp"])
    tx = tx[tx["d"] <= pd.Timestamp(as_of)]
    customers = raw["customers"][["customer_id", "country_code_clean", "region"]].rename(
        columns={"country_code_clean": "country", "region": "region"}
    )
    tx = tx.merge(customers, on="customer_id", how="left")
    tx["ym"] = tx["d"].dt.to_period("M").dt.to_timestamp()
    tx["year"] = tx["ym"].dt.year
    tx["month"] = tx["ym"].dt.month

    def index_by(key: str) -> pd.Series:
        monthly = tx.groupby([key, "ym", "year", "month"])["order_value"].sum().reset_index()
        yearly = monthly.groupby([key, "year"])["order_value"].mean().rename("year_mean").reset_index()
        monthly = monthly.merge(yearly, on=[key, "year"], how="left")
        monthly["revenue_index"] = monthly["order_value"] / monthly["year_mean"].replace(0, np.nan)
        hist = monthly[monthly["month"].isin(months)]
        prior = hist[hist["year"] < start.year]
        if len(prior):
            hist = prior
        idx = hist.groupby(key)["revenue_index"].median()
        return idx.fillna(1.0)

    country_index = index_by("country")
    region_index = index_by("region")
    country_index.name = "country_target_month_index"
    region_index.name = "region_target_month_index"

    scalars = {
        "target_window_start": start,
        "target_window_end": end,
        "target_month_start": int(start_month),
        "target_month_end": int(end.month),
        "target_month_sin": float(np.sin(2 * np.pi * start_month / 12)),
        "target_month_cos": float(np.cos(2 * np.pi * start_month / 12)),
        "target_is_holiday": int(bool(months & {11, 12})),
        "target_is_q4": int(bool(months & {10, 11, 12})),
        "target_days_to_black_friday": int((bf - start).days),
        "target_days_to_christmas": int((xmas - start).days),
        "target_is_black_friday_window": int(start <= bf <= end),
        "target_is_christmas_window": int(start <= xmas <= end),
        "target_peak_proximity": int(min(max((bf - start).days, 0), max((xmas - start).days, 0))),
    }
    return {"scalars": scalars, "country": country_index, "region": region_index}


# --------------------------------------------------------------------------- #
# Snapshot assembly
# --------------------------------------------------------------------------- #
def build_feature_frame(
    raw: dict[str, pd.DataFrame] | None = None,
    as_of=None,
    data_dir: str = DATA,
) -> pd.DataFrame:
    if raw is None:
        raw = load_raw(data_dir)
    as_of = resolve_as_of(as_of, data_dir) if as_of is None else pd.Timestamp(as_of).normalize()

    base = customer_base(raw, as_of)
    sess = session_features(raw, as_of)
    txn, txn_raw = transaction_features(raw, as_of)
    items = item_features(raw, txn_raw)
    deliv = delivery_features(raw, txn_raw)
    sup = support_features(raw, as_of)
    ret = retention_features(raw, as_of)
    reg = region_marketing_features(raw, as_of)
    budget = country_budget(raw)
    season = seasonality_context(raw, as_of)

    feats = base.copy()
    for block in (sess, txn, items, deliv, sup, ret):
        feats = feats.merge(block, left_on="customer_id", right_index=True, how="left")
    feats = feats.merge(reg, left_on="cust_region", right_index=True, how="left")
    feats = feats.merge(budget, left_on="cust_country", right_index=True, how="left")
    feats = feats.merge(season["country"], left_on="cust_country", right_index=True, how="left")
    feats = feats.merge(season["region"], left_on="cust_region", right_index=True, how="left")
    for key, value in season["scalars"].items():
        feats[key] = value

    feats["country_target_month_index"] = feats["country_target_month_index"].fillna(1.0)
    feats["region_target_month_index"] = feats["region_target_month_index"].fillna(1.0)
    feats["sess_target_month_weighted_share"] = (
        feats["sess_target_month_share"].fillna(0.0) * feats["country_target_month_index"]
    )
    feats["txn_target_month_weighted_share"] = (
        feats["txn_target_month_share"].fillna(0.0) * feats["country_target_month_index"]
    )

    count_prefixes = ("sess_n", "txn_n", "item_lines", "item_qty", "del_n", "sup_n", "ret_n",
                      "ret_redeemed_n", "ret_no_offer_n", "ret_v20_n")
    for col in feats.columns:
        if col.startswith(count_prefixes):
            feats[col] = feats[col].fillna(0)

    # Values used by the offer planner.
    feats["expected_order_value"] = np.where(
        feats["txn_n_90d"].fillna(0) > 0,
        feats["txn_spend_90d"] / feats["txn_n_90d"].replace(0, np.nan),
        feats["txn_value_mean"],
    )
    feats["expected_order_value"] = feats["expected_order_value"].fillna(60.0)
    feats["margin"] = feats["item_weighted_margin"].fillna(0.35)
    feats["item_promotable_share"] = feats["item_promotable_share"].fillna(0.0)

    r = raw["retention_contacts"][["customer_id", "contact_date"]].copy()
    r["contact_date"] = pd.to_datetime(r["contact_date"])
    last = r.groupby("customer_id")["contact_date"].max().rename("last_contact_date")
    feats = feats.merge(last, left_on="customer_id", right_index=True, how="left")

    feats["_as_of"] = pd.Timestamp(as_of)
    return feats


def build_labels(
    raw: dict[str, pd.DataFrame] | None = None,
    as_of=None,
    data_dir: str = DATA,
    customer_ids=None,
) -> pd.DataFrame:
    if raw is None:
        raw = load_raw(data_dir)
    as_of = pd.Timestamp(as_of).normalize()
    start, end = window_bounds(as_of, WINDOW_DAYS)

    tx = raw["transactions"][["customer_id", "transaction_timestamp"]].copy()
    tx["d"] = pd.to_datetime(tx["transaction_timestamp"])
    buyers = set(tx[(tx["d"] > as_of) & (tx["d"] <= end)]["customer_id"].unique())

    if customer_ids is None:
        customer_ids = raw["customers"]["customer_id"]
    ids = pd.Series(customer_ids).drop_duplicates()
    return pd.DataFrame({
        "customer_id": ids.to_numpy(),
        "target": ids.isin(buyers).astype(int).to_numpy(),
    })


def build_snapshot(
    raw: dict[str, pd.DataFrame] | None = None,
    as_of=None,
    data_dir: str = DATA,
    labelled: bool = True,
) -> pd.DataFrame:
    if raw is None:
        raw = load_raw(data_dir)
    as_of = resolve_as_of(as_of, data_dir) if as_of is None else pd.Timestamp(as_of).normalize()
    feats = build_feature_frame(raw, as_of, data_dir)
    feats["as_of"] = pd.Timestamp(as_of)
    if not labelled:
        return feats
    labels = build_labels(raw, as_of, data_dir, feats["customer_id"])
    out = feats.merge(labels, on="customer_id", how="left")
    out["target"] = out["target"].fillna(0).astype("int8")
    return out


def snapshot_dates(
    raw: dict[str, pd.DataFrame],
    as_of=None,
    count: int = 12,
    freq: str = "monthly",
    labelled: bool = True,
) -> list[pd.Timestamp]:
    """Return snapshot as-of dates ending before the latest observable label."""
    latest = resolve_as_of(as_of, DATA) if as_of is None else pd.Timestamp(as_of).normalize()
    if labelled:
        latest = (latest - pd.Timedelta(days=WINDOW_DAYS)).normalize()
    dates = month_end_dates(latest, count) if freq == "monthly" else weekly_dates(latest, count)
    return [d for d in dates if d <= latest]


def write_snapshot(df: pd.DataFrame, out_dir: str, as_of) -> str:
    os.makedirs(out_dir, exist_ok=True)
    path = os.path.join(out_dir, f"snapshot_{pd.Timestamp(as_of).date().isoformat()}.pkl")
    df.to_pickle(path)
    return path

def black_friday(year: int) -> pd.Timestamp:
    """Black Friday for a year (the day after the fourth Thursday in November)."""
    nov1 = pd.Timestamp(year=int(year), month=11, day=1)
    days_to_thursday = (3 - nov1.weekday()) % 7
    first_thursday = nov1 + pd.Timedelta(days=days_to_thursday)
    fourth_thursday = first_thursday + pd.Timedelta(days=21)
    return fourth_thursday + pd.Timedelta(days=1)

"""Build as-of snapshots for the rolling ShopSphere propensity model.

The original checkpoint uses one fixed cutoff.  This builder creates a set of
labelled historical snapshots plus one unlabelled "live" snapshot from the
latest event date.  All dates come from the data or CLI/env, never constants.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import json
import os
from datetime import datetime, timezone

import pandas as pd

import asof_features as af
from asof_time import resolve_as_of, window_bounds

BASE = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))
DEFAULT_OUT = os.path.join(BASE, "rolling", "snapshots")
DEFAULT_LIVE = os.path.join(BASE, "rolling", "live_features.pkl")


def build(args) -> dict:
    raw = af.load_raw(args.data_dir)
    latest = resolve_as_of(args.as_of, args.data_dir)
    dates = af.snapshot_dates(
        raw, as_of=latest, count=args.count, freq=args.freq, labelled=True
    )
    os.makedirs(args.out_dir, exist_ok=True)

    manifest = {
        "generated_at": datetime.now(timezone.utc).replace(microsecond=0).isoformat(),
        "latest_data_date": str(latest.date()),
        "window_days": af.WINDOW_DAYS,
        "freq": args.freq,
        "snapshots": [],
    }

    for as_of in dates:
        path = os.path.join(args.out_dir, f"snapshot_{as_of.date().isoformat()}.pkl")
        if os.path.exists(path) and not args.overwrite:
            df = pd.read_pickle(path)
        else:
            df = af.build_snapshot(raw, as_of, args.data_dir, labelled=True)
            df.to_pickle(path)
        start, end = window_bounds(as_of, af.WINDOW_DAYS)
        manifest["snapshots"].append({
            "as_of": str(as_of.date()),
            "window_start": str(start.date()),
            "window_end": str(end.date()),
            "rows": int(len(df)),
            "positive_rate": round(float(df["target"].mean()), 5),
            "path": path,
        })
        print(f"snapshot {as_of.date()} rows={len(df):,} positive={df['target'].mean():.3%}")

    live_as_of = latest
    live = af.build_snapshot(raw, live_as_of, args.data_dir, labelled=False)
    live_path = args.live_out
    os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(live_path), exist_ok=True)
    live.to_pickle(live_path)
    start, end = window_bounds(live_as_of, af.WINDOW_DAYS)
    manifest["live"] = {
        "as_of": str(live_as_of.date()),
        "window_start": str(start.date()),
        "window_end": str(end.date()),
        "rows": int(len(live)),
        "path": live_path,
    }
    print(f"live snapshot {live_as_of.date()} rows={len(live):,} -> {live_path}")

    manifest_path = os.path.join(args.out_dir, "manifest.json")
    with open(manifest_path, "w", encoding="utf-8") as fh:
        json.dump(manifest, fh, indent=2)
    print(f"manifest -> {manifest_path}")
    return manifest


def main() -> None:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="Build rolling ShopSphere snapshots")
    parser.add_argument("--as-of", default=None,
                        help="Latest data date (default: derive from data or SHOPSPHERE_AS_OF)")
    parser.add_argument("--data-dir", default=af.DATA)
    parser.add_argument("--count", type=int, default=12,
                        help="Number of labelled historical snapshots")
    parser.add_argument("--freq", choices=["monthly", "weekly"], default="monthly")
    parser.add_argument("--out-dir", default=DEFAULT_OUT)
    parser.add_argument("--live-out", default=DEFAULT_LIVE)
    parser.add_argument("--overwrite", action="store_true")
    args = parser.parse_args()
    build(args)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
